card.name: Preparation setting and equipment wording
card.fires_on: Small words and word parts inside preparation instructions, mainly 'a' in 'a suitable work area such as a laminar flow hood'. It also fires on words about automated or mechanical admixing and compounding devices.

modes.label: Work area phrase
modes.description: The word 'a' right after 'suitable work area such as', before laminar flow hood.

modes.description: Words describing automated, manual or mechanical compounding or reconstitution equipment.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are Chinese medical-practice terms and the suppressed ones are business and production terms, so the output effect is only loosely clinical.
card.plain: It lights up on the wording about where and with what equipment injections are prepared or mixed.
